description: This file is a C source file implementing logging functionalities for a software project, including setting log file paths, logging messages with timestamps and colors, and prefix-based logging. It manages log file creation, message formatting, and output to both console and files.

methods.name: void UT_log_setLogFilePath(char * inputFilePath)
methods.description: Sets the log file path and name with a timestamp appended, initializing the global log filename variable.

methods.name: const char * UT_log_getLogFilename(void)
methods.description: Returns the current log filename being used.

methods.name: void UT_log(const char * function,int line,const char * format,...)
methods.description: Logs a message with timestamp, function name, line number, and formatted message, writing to both stdout and the log file.

methods.name: void UT_logPrefix(const char * file,int line,const char * prefix,const char * format,...)
methods.description: Logs a message with a prefix, timestamp, and filename info, writing to stdout and the log file, with optional color code stripping.

methods.name: char * UT_stripColorCode(char * in_string)
methods.description: Removes ANSI color codes from a string.
